title: SOIL EROSION AND CONSERVATION
modules: Matching Land Uses To Land Types
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are considered detachment by raindrop impact, detachment by overland flow and soil transportation by overland flow."
Three erosion processes are considered detachment by raindrop impact, detachment by overland flow and soil transportation by overland flow.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a major source of sediment and nutrient loss."
Gullying is a major source of sediment and nutrient loss.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an important factor for crop and livestock production."
Soil is an important factor for crop and livestock production.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the result of a complex interaction among a number of interdependent components."
The farming system is the result of a complex interaction among a number of interdependent components.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a lumped parameter that represents an integrated average annual value of the soil profile reaction to the processes of soil detachment and transport by raindrop impact and surface flow."

The K-factor is a lumped parameter that represents an integrated average annual value of the soil profile reaction to the processes of soil detachment and transport by raindrop impact and surface flow.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is known as Conservation tillage which is describes as the method of seedbed preparation that includes the presence of residue mulch and an increase in surface roughness as key criteria."

Soil management strategies is known as Conservation tillage which is describes as the method of seedbed preparation that includes the presence of residue mulch and an increase in surface roughness as key criteria.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the main cause of aggregate breakdown in most soils, either directly by rainfall or by surface runoff."
Water is the main cause of aggregate breakdown in most soils, either directly by rainfall or by surface runoff.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the most common type of soil erosion."
Inter rill is the most common type of soil erosion.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a function of particle detachment, rainfall intensity, and field slope."
Inter rill erosion is a function of particle detachment, rainfall intensity, and field slope.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those where the systematic cultivation of cash crops is practiced in addition to production for household needs."
Partly commercialized farms are those where the systematic cultivation of cash crops is practiced in addition to production for household needs.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the complete breakdown of aggregates into primary particles because the attractive forces holding the particles together are lessened by wetting."
Physicochemical dispersion is the complete breakdown of aggregates into primary particles because the attractive forces holding the particles together are lessened by wetting.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an empirically derived, „grey box‟, soil loss prediction methodology, developed at the National Runoff and Soil Data Centre in co-operation with Purdue University."

The Universal Soil Loss Equation (USLE) is an empirically derived, „grey box‟, soil loss prediction methodology, developed at the National Runoff and Soil Data Centre in co-operation with Purdue University.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the most complex and dynamic soil properties affecting principal physical and hydraulic soil characteristics, such as infiltration rate, hydraulic conductivity and erodibility."

Aggregate stability is one of the most complex and dynamic soil properties affecting principal physical and hydraulic soil characteristics, such as infiltration rate, hydraulic conductivity and erodibility.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a layer of dissimilar material placed between the soil surface and the atmosphere."
Mulch is a layer of dissimilar material placed between the soil surface and the atmosphere.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the key to the success in any soil conservation programme."
Farmer participation is the key to the success in any soil conservation programme.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is known to pick up soil and shift it to another space whilst it does so the actual soil decomposes and loses its soil particles."
Wind is known to pick up soil and shift it to another space whilst it does so the actual soil decomposes and loses its soil particles.
